author: Blyth, 1843
habitat: 관목이 있는 개활지, 농경지, 초지, 낮은 구릉

months.note: 주로 5월과 9월 초순~11월 초순에 섬 지역의 풀밭에서 기록되며, 국내에서 기록된 달이다.

summary: 해마다 10건 미만으로 드물게 기록되는 새로, 관목이 있는 개활지, 농경지, 초지, 낮은 구릉에 산다. 생김새는 작은 메추라기를 닮았다. 땅을 오목하게 파서 둥지를 만들고 알을 4개 낳으며, 알 품기는 수컷이 맡는다. 아무르강에서 황하 하류, 태국, 동남아시아에 걸쳐 분포한다.

points.en: rufous head spotted blackish-brown and white

points.ko: 가슴 옆과 옆구리의 둥근 흑갈색 반점
points.en: round blackish-brown spots on breast sides and flanks

sexes.male: 암컷보다 작고 색이 수수하며, 뒷목의 적갈색 띠가 없다.
sexes.female: 수컷보다 크고 색이 선명하며, 뒷목에서 윗가슴에 걸쳐 넓은 적갈색 띠가 있다.

young: 어린새는 수컷과 비슷하나 색이 더 칙칙하고, 뒷목의 적갈색 띠가 없거나 흐릿하다.

art.subject: Yellow-legged Buttonquail (Turnix tanki), adult female, as seen at Korean farmland edges on spring or autumn passage: head warm buff-brown, densely speckled blackish and white; a bright rufous-orange patch across the hindneck; throat white; back and scapulars grey-brown, finely vermiculated and spotted dark with buff feather edges; wing coverts pale buff with bold round black spots; breast warm orange-buff, paling to whitish-buff on the belly; breast sides and flanks with rows of round blackish-brown spots; bill yellow; iris pale, whitish; legs and feet bright yellow.
art.pose: walking on the ground among low grass
art.scene: Korean farmland edge with grassy open ground and scattered shrubs during spring or autumn migration; no people, buildings or text
views: adult female, side view walking through short grass: buff-brown head speckled blackish and white, rufous-orange hindneck patch, white throat, grey-brown back, black-spotted pale buff wing coverts, orange-buff breast, round blackish spots on breast sides and flanks, yellow bill, bright yellow three-toed legs

adult male, side view standing: like the female but smaller and duller, with little or no rufous on the hindneck; same white throat, spotted breast sides and flanks, yellowish-buff belly and bright yellow legs
adult, front view: white throat, warm orange-buff breast with round blackish-brown spots at the sides, paler buff belly, yellow bill and legs
art.build: Tiny, rotund, quail-like ground bird, 13cm, about sparrow length but much rounder and clearly smaller than Japanese Quail; body carried low, small head, short neck. Bill short and fairly slender, shorter than the head, yellow. Legs medium length, bright yellow, with three forward toes and no hind toe. Wings short and rounded; the tiny tail is hidden at rest. Flushes low on whirring wings, showing pale buff black-spotted wing coverts against darker flight feathers, then drops back into cover. The female is larger and brighter than the male.
avoid: Do not draw a hind toe or a visible tail; buttonquails have three forward toes only and a tiny tail hidden at rest.
Do not paint pinkish or grey legs or long pale stripes over the head and back; that is Japanese Quail (Coturnix japonica).
Do not give it a black throat or a finely barred breast; that is Barred Buttonquail (Turnix suscitator).
Do not paint streaks on the flanks; the flank marks are round spots.
